name: write-hql
description: Write, validate, and run HQL (Harness Query Language) queries against Harness data, and analyze pipeline, deployment, CI and security data with them. Use when asked to write, fix, explain, or validate an HQL query, create dashboard widget queries, find which types and fields can be queried, or answer "how many", "top N", trend, dashboard widget, or failure-rate questions over a time window or many runs. Do NOT use for the current state of one named pipeline run (use debug-pipeline) or for cloud cost totals (use analyze-costs). Trigger phrases: HQL, Harness Query Language, write a query, validate query, queryable types.
